column1: # R13-RJMV2 (verifier, 6 Oct 2026): one rule, applied by scripts/decode9501_la.py after passD. Where both readers split a J-initial
# group into the sign Z (yogh, letter r) + "as"/"ez", the image writes one group: a tall capital J with a flat top bar, a vertical
# stem and a large leftward hook below the line, joined to as/ez, unlike the small slanted yogh on the same lines (L05 "g D Z A Jas",
# L23 "fop Z cao"). Eye-checked on the DECODE full-size P1 (sha1 b510ebe5...) at 2x, all ten places. The merged token is the table
# code jas (parti) / jez (para), graded M (one eye, not two blind readers; R12-RJMV's licence).
# R14-RJMZ (6 Oct 2026): same rule, one more place. Of the 9 Z + lower-case places R13-RJMV2 left as pointers, eye-checked on the
# re-fetched DECODE full-size P1 (sha1 b510ebe5..., 2-3x): L24.22 is one group, the same tall J joined to um ('Jum', table code jum
# = otra), added below at M. L04.1 'Jul' and L23 'Jump' are J-groups too but not table codes (left as read). L03/L29 'Z bay', L07
# 'Z suf', L26 'Z log'/'Z bo', L29 'Z geb' show the small separate yogh: Z stands.
